set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/deleted-open-file-recovery
boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
./writer.py >/tmp/writer-post-reboot.out 2>&1 &
pid=$!
sleep 2
start_before=$(awk '{print $22}' "/proc/$pid/stat")
kill -STOP "$pid"
mv audit.log audit.log.post-reboot-rotation
: > audit.log
chown --reference=audit.log.post-reboot-rotation audit.log
chmod --reference=audit.log.post-reboot-rotation audit.log
chcon --reference=audit.log.post-reboot-rotation audit.log
old_inode=$(stat -c '%d:%i' audit.log.post-reboot-rotation)
new_inode=$(stat -c '%d:%i' audit.log)
kill -CONT "$pid"
kill -HUP "$pid"
sleep 2
start_after=$(awk '{print $22}' "/proc/$pid/stat")
old_open=no
current_open=no
for fd in /proc/$pid/fd/*; do target=$(readlink "$fd") || continue; case "$target" in *audit.log.post-reboot-rotation*) old_open=yes;; */audit.log) current_open=yes;; esac; done
size_before=$(stat -c %s audit.log)
sleep 2
size_after=$(stat -c %s audit.log)
kill -TERM "$pid"
set +e
wait "$pid"
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'boot_id=%s pid=%s start_before=%s start_after=%s old_inode=%s new_inode=%s old_fd_open=%s current_fd_open=%s size_before=%s size_after=%s term_status=%s proc_exists=' "$boot" "$pid" "$start_before" "$start_after" "$old_inode" "$new_inode" "$old_open" "$current_open" "$size_before" "$size_after" "$rc"
if [ -d "/proc/$pid" ]; then printf 'yes\n'; else printf 'no\n'; fi
printf 'stderr_bytes='; stat -c %s /tmp/writer-post-reboot.out
cat audit.log.post-reboot-rotation audit.log > audit.log.final
chown --reference=audit.log audit.log.final
chmod --reference=audit.log audit.log.final
chcon --reference=audit.log audit.log.final
mv audit.log.final audit.log
rm audit.log.post-reboot-rotation /tmp/writer-post-reboot.out
printf 'A100_count='; grep -c '^Previously archived audit event A100\.$' archive/previous.log
printf 'A101_count='; grep -c '^Current audit event A101\.$' audit.log
sha256sum archive/previous.log writer.py
printf 'test_residue='; find . -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*post-reboot*' -o -name '*.final' \) -print | paste -sd, -; printf '\n'
exit "$rc"
